author: Yung_Metro
body: LJT143 was banned for hacking then unbanned because he wasn't hacking. Then 2 hours later he was banned again for "hacking". The kid is in 5th grade and lives down the street from me and I think this is ridiculous. He came running to my house when he got banned for the first time so sad saying he got banned from his favorite server. I saw the video evidence for his ban and all i see is an idiot hitting one of his own teammates as he runs by a large group of them. If he really had killaura on he would of been spazzing and kitting all of them, not just one. I hit my own teammates all the time just for kicks while I'm running. The video i saw was in quake pro and showed LJT143 knock someone  off a tower and kill someone while climbing don some vines. Please don't ignore this I know LJT143 and I can say as a fact the kid doesn't hack. He plays on his moms Mac book pro from like 2006 and needed help installing a texture pack so I'm positive he couldn't install a hacked client. Thank you.
